```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# ============================================================
# 03_feature_engineering.R
# Airline Service Performance Visual Analytics
# ============================================================


# 1. LOAD PACKAGE ---------------------------------------------------------

library(dplyr)


# 2. FILE PATHS -----------------------------------------------------------

input_path <- "D:/data-portfolio/08_airline_service_performance_visual_analytics/data/processed/airline_performance_clean.csv"

output_path <- "D:/data-portfolio/08_airline_service_performance_visual_analytics/data/processed/airline_performance_analysis.csv"


# 3. READ CLEAN DATA ------------------------------------------------------

clean_data <- read.csv(
  input_path,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE,
  na.strings = c("", "NA")
)

cat("\n=== CLEAN DATA IMPORTED ===\n")

cat(
  "Number of rows:",
  nrow(clean_data),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Number of columns:",
  ncol(clean_data),
  "\n"
)


# 4. RESTORE DATE FORMAT --------------------------------------------------

clean_data$Month <- as.Date(
  clean_data$Month
)


cat("\n=== DATE CHECK ===\n")

cat(
  "Date range:",
  as.character(min(clean_data$Month)),
  "to",
  as.character(max(clean_data$Month)),
  "\n"
)


# 5. CREATE TIME VARIABLES ------------------------------------------------

analysis_data <- clean_data %>%
  mutate(
    Year = as.integer(
      format(Month, "%Y")
    ),
    
    Month_Number = as.integer(
      format(Month, "%m")
    ),
    
    Month_Name = month.abb[
      Month_Number
    ]
  )


cat("\n=== TIME VARIABLES ===\n")

cat(
  "Number of years:",
  n_distinct(analysis_data$Year),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "First year:",
  min(analysis_data$Year),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Last year:",
  max(analysis_data$Year),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Month numbers:",
  paste(
    sort(
      unique(analysis_data$Month_Number)
    ),
    collapse = ", "
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Month names:",
  paste(
    month.abb,
    collapse = ", "
  ),
  "\n"
)


# 6. CREATE ANALYSIS LEVEL ------------------------------------------------

analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(
    Analysis_Level = case_when(
      
      Route == "All Ports-All Ports" &
        Airline == "All Airlines" ~
        "Network",
      
      Route == "All Ports-All Ports" &
        Airline != "All Airlines" ~
        "Airline",
      
      Route != "All Ports-All Ports" &
        Airline == "All Airlines" ~
        "Route",
      
      TRUE ~
        "Airline Route"
    )
  )


cat("\n=== ANALYSIS LEVELS ===\n")

analysis_level_summary <- analysis_data %>%
  count(
    Analysis_Level
  )

print(
  analysis_level_summary
)


cat(
  "Total rows across analysis levels:",
  sum(analysis_level_summary$n),
  "\n"
)


# 7. CREATE THE FOUR ANALYTICAL LAYERS ------------------------------------

network_month <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(
    Analysis_Level == "Network"
  )


airline_month <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(
    Analysis_Level == "Airline"
  )


route_month <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(
    Analysis_Level == "Route"
  )


airline_route_month <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(
    Analysis_Level == "Airline Route"
  )


cat("\n=== ANALYTICAL LAYER ROW COUNTS ===\n")

cat(
  "Network-month rows:",
  nrow(network_month),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Airline-month rows:",
  nrow(airline_month),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Route-month rows:",
  nrow(route_month),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Airline-route-month rows:",
  nrow(airline_route_month),
  "\n"
)


# 8. CHECK NETWORK-MONTH STRUCTURE ----------------------------------------

network_month_check <- network_month %>%
  count(
    Month
  ) %>%
  filter(
    n != 1
  )


cat("\n=== NETWORK-MONTH CHECK ===\n")

cat(
  "Network months:",
  n_distinct(network_month$Month),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Months without exactly one network record:",
  nrow(network_month_check),
  "\n"
)


# 9. RECALCULATE ROW-LEVEL PERFORMANCE -----------------------------------

metric_check <- analysis_data %>%
  mutate(
    
    Calculated_Departure_OTP = ifelse(
      Sectors_Flown > 0,
      Departures_On_Time /
        Sectors_Flown * 100,
      NA
    ),
    
    Calculated_Arrival_OTP = ifelse(
      Sectors_Flown > 0,
      Arrivals_On_Time /
        Sectors_Flown * 100,
      NA
    ),
    
    Calculated_Cancellation_Rate = ifelse(
      Sectors_Scheduled > 0,
      Cancellations /
        Sectors_Scheduled * 100,
      NA
    )
  )


# 10. COMPARE CALCULATED AND PUBLISHED PERCENTAGES ------------------------

metric_check <- metric_check %>%
  mutate(
    
    Departure_OTP_Difference =
      Calculated_Departure_OTP -
      OnTime_Departures_Percent,
    
    Arrival_OTP_Difference =
      Calculated_Arrival_OTP -
      OnTime_Arrivals_Percent,
    
    Cancellation_Rate_Difference =
      Calculated_Cancellation_Rate -
      Cancellations_Percent
  )


cat("\n=== PERFORMANCE METRIC VALIDATION ===\n")

cat(
  "Maximum Departure OTP difference:",
  max(
    abs(metric_check$Departure_OTP_Difference),
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Maximum Arrival OTP difference:",
  max(
    abs(metric_check$Arrival_OTP_Difference),
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Maximum Cancellation Rate difference:",
  max(
    abs(metric_check$Cancellation_Rate_Difference),
    na.rm = TRUE
  ),
  "\n"
)


# 11. DEMONSTRATE WEIGHTED AGGREGATION -----------------------------------

network_metric_example <- network_month %>%
  summarise(
    
    Total_Sectors_Flown =
      sum(Sectors_Flown),
    
    Total_Sectors_Scheduled =
      sum(Sectors_Scheduled),
    
    Total_Departures_On_Time =
      sum(Departures_On_Time),
    
    Total_Arrivals_On_Time =
      sum(Arrivals_On_Time),
    
    Total_Cancellations =
      sum(Cancellations),
    
    Weighted_Departure_OTP =
      sum(Departures_On_Time) /
      sum(Sectors_Flown) * 100,
    
    Weighted_Arrival_OTP =
      sum(Arrivals_On_Time) /
      sum(Sectors_Flown) * 100,
    
    Weighted_Cancellation_Rate =
      sum(Cancellations) /
      sum(Sectors_Scheduled) * 100,
    
    Simple_Mean_Departure_OTP =
      mean(
        OnTime_Departures_Percent,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    Simple_Mean_Arrival_OTP =
      mean(
        OnTime_Arrivals_Percent,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    
    Simple_Mean_Cancellation_Rate =
      mean(
        Cancellations_Percent,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
  )


cat("\n=== WEIGHTED AGGREGATION EXAMPLE ===\n")

print(
  network_metric_example
)


# 12. CHECK MISSING ANALYSIS LEVELS ---------------------------------------

missing_analysis_level <- analysis_data %>%
  filter(
    is.na(Analysis_Level)
  )


cat("\n=== ANALYSIS LEVEL VALIDATION ===\n")

cat(
  "Rows with missing analysis level:",
  nrow(missing_analysis_level),
  "\n"
)


# 13. SELECT FINAL ANALYTICAL VARIABLES -----------------------------------

analysis_data <- analysis_data %>%
  select(
    Route,
    Departing_Port,
    Arriving_Port,
    Airline,
    Month,
    Year,
    Month_Number,
    Month_Name,
    Analysis_Level,
    Sectors_Scheduled,
    Sectors_Flown,
    Cancellations,
    Departures_On_Time,
    Arrivals_On_Time,
    Departures_Delayed,
    Arrivals_Delayed,
    OnTime_Departures_Percent,
    OnTime_Arrivals_Percent,
    Cancellations_Percent
  )


# 14. FINAL ANALYSIS DATASET CHECK ----------------------------------------

cat("\n=== FINAL ANALYSIS DATASET ===\n")

cat(
  "Number of rows:",
  nrow(analysis_data),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Number of columns:",
  ncol(analysis_data),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Number of analysis levels:",
  n_distinct(analysis_data$Analysis_Level),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Number of years:",
  n_distinct(analysis_data$Year),
  "\n"
)

cat(
  "Number of months:",
  n_distinct(analysis_data$Month),
  "\n"
)


cat("\nFinal analysis level counts:\n")

print(
  analysis_data %>%
    count(
      Analysis_Level
    )
)


# 15. SAVE ANALYSIS DATA --------------------------------------------------

write.csv(
  analysis_data,
  output_path,
  row.names = FALSE,
  na = ""
)


cat("\n=== FILE EXPORTED ===\n")

cat(
  "Analysis data saved to:",
  output_path,
  "\n"
)


# 16. FEATURE ENGINEERING FINISHED ----------------------------------------

cat("\n=== FEATURE ENGINEERING FINISHED ===\n")
```
